name: Chapter switcher menu
definition: Top-bar dropdown that shows the current chapter and lists every chapter and slide for direct jumps.
bestUse: Long talks where the presenter or audience needs to jump between chapters.

demo.how: The demo shows a four-slide mini deck with a chapter menu in its top bar. Open the menu and pick a slide to jump there; Replay walks through an automatic jump. The label always names the chapter you are in.
